title: How to Cancel Apple TV+ — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Apple TV+ subscription in under a minute. Stop the $9.99/mo charge through iPhone, Mac, or web. Keep access until billing period ends.
intro: Apple TV+ uses the same subscription management as all Apple services. Cancel it through your Apple ID settings — it takes about 60 seconds regardless of which device you use.

steps.title: Open Apple subscription settings
steps.text: On iPhone: Settings → your name → Subscriptions. On Mac: App Store → Account → Subscriptions. On web: appleid.apple.com → Subscriptions.

steps.title: Select Apple TV+
steps.text: Find Apple TV+ in your active subscriptions list and tap on it. You'll see your plan details and next renewal date.
steps.tip: If you don't see Apple TV+ listed, you may have it through Apple One bundle or a free trial from a device purchase.

steps.title: Tap "Cancel Subscription"
steps.text: Tap "Cancel Subscription" at the bottom. If you're on a free trial (included with device purchases), tap "Cancel Free Trial".
steps.tip: Apple gives up to 3 months free TV+ with new device purchases. Set a reminder before it auto-renews at $9.99/mo.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.text: Confirm your cancellation. You keep access until the end of your current billing period or trial. Downloaded shows will become unavailable after expiration.

warnings: Apple TV+ often comes as a free trial with new Apple device purchases. Mark your calendar — it auto-renews at $9.99/mo after the trial.
If you're subscribed through Apple One, you need to cancel the entire bundle or switch to individual services.
Downloaded content becomes unplayable after cancellation.
Family Sharing members all lose access if the family organizer cancels.

faqs.q: Do I get Apple TV+ free with my new iPhone?
faqs.a: Apple offers 3 months free Apple TV+ with the purchase of a new Apple device. After the trial, it auto-renews at $9.99/mo unless you cancel before the trial ends.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for Apple TV+?
faqs.a: Yes. Visit reportaproblem.apple.com and request a refund for recent charges. Apple is generally accommodating for accidental renewals.

faqs.q: What happens to movies I purchased on Apple TV?
faqs.a: Movies and shows you purchased (bought, not through the subscription) remain yours permanently. Only Apple TV+ Originals require an active subscription to watch.

faqs.q: Is there a cheaper Apple TV+ plan?
faqs.a: No. Apple TV+ only has one tier at $9.99/mo. However, Apple One ($19.95/mo) bundles TV+ with Music, iCloud+, and Arcade, which may be cheaper than subscribing separately.

refund.details: Request refunds at reportaproblem.apple.com. Apple typically grants refunds for recent charges, especially for forgotten free trial auto-renewals.

retentionTactics: Apple may offer an extended free period or discount.
They'll highlight upcoming original content releases.
